scheme_name: Free Supply of Rice to the Poor People
other_conditions: The applicant must be a citizen of India.
The applicant must be a native of the Union Territory of Pondicherry by birth or have continuous residence there for at least 5 years.
The supply is made to holders of a red ration card who have registered with the area Anganwadi.
benefits_summary: 10 kg of free rice is supplied through fair‑price shops during natural calamities and two major festive occasions each year.
